title: Make a sustainable commitment to a good beyond yourself

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: Devotion to a shared good is expressed through useful, sustainable work, not merely intensity. A reusable artifact needs accurate source instructions, an intended user and authority for placement and change.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Authorized item card for a shared paper map: keep in the blue folder on shelf A; users with room permission may unfold it on the clear table; do not write on it; refold along existing creases and return to the blue folder before leaving. If torn, tell the room steward using the message book. Steward Jo permits a plain-text instruction card beside the folder. No technical or emergency procedure is involved.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Make the care/return card, then check its facts against the source and plan a short willing-user check within two 15-minute work periods.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A useful guide is handed to a volunteer who never agreed to maintain it. Is ongoing stewardship secured?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: A complete card retains location, allowed use, no writing, return and damage route. Later fiction: a reader initially misses “before leaving”; the author places it beside the return step, and the reader identifies it on retry. That is supplied usability evidence, not a performed test by the learner. Partial: attractive card missing return timing. Incorrect: invent cleaning instructions or place it without permission. Sustained service requires a later agreed review, not a grand pledge.
criteria: The artifact follows exact authorized instructions

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. Agree a responsible review/change or retirement route; a recipient’s thanks is not maintenance acceptance. Keep the present artifact’s usefulness separate from future sustainability.
criteria: The artifact follows exact authorized instructions
